title: Heavy Rain Closes Roads
text:
Heavy rain caused problems in the city of Riverton yesterday. Many roads were closed because of flooding. The local police asked drivers to stay at home if possible. Buses stopped for about three hours in the afternoon.

The rain started at noon and stopped at night. Workers cleaned the streets early this morning. Most roads are now open again. The mayor said the city will build better drains next year.

questions.text: Why were many roads closed in Riverton?
What can the reader infer about the police's advice to drivers?
options: They wanted to reduce traffic on dangerous roads
They wanted drivers to watch the rain
They were happy about the weather
They wanted drivers to buy new cars

questions.text: What does the mayor's plan suggest about the city?
options: The city has had drainage problems
The roads were built last week

vocabulary.definition: water covering land that is normally dry
people who operate cars, buses or other vehicles
pipes or channels that carry away water

paragraph_translations: A chuva forte causou problemas na cidade de Riverton ontem. Muitas estradas foram fechadas por causa da inundação. A polícia local pediu aos motoristas que ficassem em casa, se possível. Os ônibus pararam por cerca de três horas à tarde.

A chuva começou ao meio-dia e parou à noite. Os trabalhadores limparam as ruas cedo esta manhã. A maioria das estradas está aberta novamente. O prefeito disse que a cidade vai construir melhores drenos no próximo ano.
